notes.title: v1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Well, it’s finally here. Pennylooter 1.0. I still remember when The Developer first approached me with a 20 pound sack full of pennies and swallowed each and every one. At the end, he started convulsing, sobbing, and retching - a cacophony of agony that finally climaxed in the expulsion of millions of pennies from his skin. I offered him assistance, but he only said “write this down! Write this down!” With this momentous occasion, the deepest denizens of the land emerge for the final showdown. The thread of destiny presents itself to you, and offers a chance to finally claim revenge on the creator of this journey, if you are willing to pull on the taut strings of reality.   


New BossesAmy Eightlegs
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/0a24a7c07740e4c959c708576d67ab1a1d5ebf37.gif"]

Method acting has taken some down strange routes. None know this road better than Amy Eightlegs; born a normal human, Amy knew she was destined for the big screen. When she finally landed the lead role in “Janitors VS Giant Octopus: Crying Over Spilled Ink,” she immediately began preparations. After 13 excruciating months of plastic surgery, mind melds, and DNA replacement, Amy found her true form as an 80 foot tall octopus. Unfortunately, she turned to villainy after the procedures rendered her unable to vocalize coherently, and thus unfit to voice the role of Roctopus in the movie.   

I had the pleasure to interview Amy recently on my talk show. Check it out!  

Writer: “So how are you reacting to the news of being fired from your latest role?”  

Amy: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOSHHHHH 

W: Okay, I don't really care for your tone? And I hear you spawn in at…wave 45? What's that all about? I mean, an actor of your caliber, appearing this late in the game? That feels like a bit of an octo-miss!  

(5 minutes is allowed for the audience to cease their deafening laughter and applause) 

A: BLOOOOOOSHHHH  

W: Okay man, I get it, this bit isn't that good. Amy spawns after wave 44, fires ink lasers at you, and can blow ink bubbles that spawn smaller sub-bubbles (or Subbles). Does that sound right, Amy?  

A: SKASSSSSSHHHHHHHHH  




Remmy Ribbit
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/adea1f6ec99853cbc9317c8d22a40cd317364f36.gif"]

We are CONSTANTLY receiving complaints from concerned players, hundreds, maybe even thousands of carrier pigeons hourly, all asking and stating the same things: “where are the frogs,” “frog patch when,” “Pennylooter could compete with American Football if it had frogs,” “when Pennylooter adds frogs, I will be able to delete the rest of my Steam library,” and so on. 

We hear you. The last patch was originally “The Frog-date,” and it added a very delicate ecosystem of every known species of frog into Pennylooter, each with unique habitats, behaviors, and taste in music. Unfortunately, Remmy Ribbit appeared right before launch, and promptly devoured all of the frogs we created. I asked The Developer why he would create such a creature, but all he did was exclaim “my frogs! My frogs are missing!” for 12 minutes straight before crying hysterically.  

Hopping into action at wave 50, Remmy is relentless. Empowered by trillions of his brethren, he stands as one of your most dangerous opponents yet. He has two forms of attack: atomically charged frog jumps, and frogs themselves, hurtling towards you. So many innocent frogs, turned into artillery. God rest your small souls.   




Princeton the Penguin
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/50e1881c0aecb307ec97d3065481b0180df09337.png"]

Forget anything else I have ever said about any of the other bosses. Princeton the Penguin is the most heinous of them all. Together, with an entire gang of formerly innocent penguins that he has hypnotized into tearing you limb from limb, he is here to make your life worse. In fact, here’s a pro-gamer tip for you, completely free: if you shoot a penguin enough times, it WILL die. This even applies to psychic penguins.  

Princeton pops in after wave 54. Fun fact about the number 54: it is the atomic number of the element Xenon. Here's another one: Princeton, like most penguins, is armed with immense psychic strength. Unlike most penguins, he lacks any sense of decency, and will use those powers to launch homing snowballs and concentrated beams of pure Penguin Spunk right at you.   




The Developer
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/a603c0e79cdcb811df366223af6014abedb44738.gif"]

I suppose it’s time we finally come clean. Pennylooter is not a “game.” At least, not for you. It is the culmination of hundreds of years of human engineering, esoteric rituals, and senseless, senseless sacrifice. All for the sake of holding back the greatest power of all: The Developer. A deity of immense strength, he was limited only by his warped perception that reality is just a video game. This was used against him to trap him in this digital form; as long as the game continues, he will be ignorant to the fact that there is another realm available for him to fill with sentient trees, yetis, and psychic penguins. He demands entertainment. Play the game.   

Clear 54 waves, and he will slink forth. He does not play fair; the fragile rules of reality are against you.   




The Map
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/bb37925f3e0298917468e0d8201b0aaaecfe2b0b.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/209fc7c3f21c7c00b6c7be054482922eae512387.png"]

This is one of the most monumental additions to any video game ever, and here's why: Pennylooter's generation is based on seeds. That means that, in order to add this item, The Developer had to painstakingly draw out every single possible seed's world layout. That's more maps than there are atoms in an elephant (i.e. at least THOUSANDS). You better be grateful.  

The map, when obtained, will display your current location and the location of shops, and you can also drop pins on the map to mark other places of interest. If you unlock the Marathon achievement by travelling 42 kilometers (or approximately 39,370 inches), then you will always start with a map.   




New Items
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/ee135739832a9398d9541cc3ad60bac1b85fa6ca.png"]

Listen fella, I'm not gonna sit here, hold your pretty little hands, and talk you through every blessed line of code that was added to this god forsaken game. Do I sound like a tour guide? Have these patch notes ever actually said anything useful regarding things like “balance” or “what a boss fight is actually like” or “finally resolved the ‘Meat Mansion Massacre’ bug”? Oh, you've never heard of the Meat Mansion? That's because there isn't one. I made it up. But no one was shooting Archduke Franz Ferdinand, the heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne, either, until someone was! Yes sir, I am appropriating ANOTHER tragedy for the sake of comparison just to make a point, since tragedy and exaggeration is the only thing you seem to comprehend. In an age of divided attention, brutality demands headlines.  

Look, maybe we got off on the wrong foot here. Earlier, I asked several rhetorical questions. In the interest of being more “transparent” or whatever, here is the answer to all of them: 

“Yes, Pennylooter is being sponsored by Gut Mustard cleaning products, and yes, these products have been known to cause irreversible damage to the respiratory, nervous, skeletal, circulatory, cardiovascular, digestive, respiratory (again) and temporal systems. We know this causes a great deal of concern regarding our ethics, business practices, and sense of basic human morality. But you should consider this: there are bugs in your skin.” 

I sincerely hope that clears some things up about what exactly we added to the game.   



So like, i know I kind of went off up there for the final section and you don't have to use it. It would be funny if you did though. Would be even funnier if you kept this part in too. Keep it real, keep it fresh you know, like a, like a baby bird in sunglasses-type fresh. - Patch Notes Writer




Small Changes and Bug Fixes
 Improved UI navigation with gamepads

 Some visual improvements to the UI

 Gamepad controls are now displayed on screen

 Native controller support for more types of controllers

 Added sound effects for the Bow and Arrow and the Bloodgun

 Fixed a crash that could occur during the tutorial

 Fixed a bug that allowed the player to duplicate the starting item during the tutorial

 Retextured Phillip McTree, Boulder Beast, and the exterior of the Shop

 Fixed a bug that caused altars to sometimes despawn shortly after appearing, making them impossible to get to

 Reduced the price of Healthy Stench and increased its rarity

 Changes to cooldown and shop music

 Improved the effect of knockback on the player

 Fixed various collision issues (you can't phase through the shop's walls anymore)

 Added shelves in the shop

 The fungus biome is now unlocked by defeating Anita

 Animated the wings given by Dev's Blessing

 Rebalanced various item unlocks; defeating each boss unlocks two items, one for normal difficulty and one for hard mode

 Armor pieces will no longer appear in the shop if the player is already wearing them

 Fixed special magazine meter colors for the Blood and Penny guns not resetting when switching back to a normal weapon

 Added a credits screen

 Reworked and improved the tutorial

 Fixed blinker enemies sometimes spawning on top of the player

 Enemies now flash red when damaged, like the player

 The damage numbers that appear above enemies can be toggled on/off in the settings, and they're now off by default

 On gamepads, guns now reload automatically when the magazine is emptied

 Recently unlocked items will now be highlighted in the shop

 Reworked the save system to work like traditional roguelikes. All your achievements and unlocks will be automatically migrated to the new system

 Reworked progression (it doesn't take as long to get through the game now)

 Fixed dropped items disappearing in the shop

notes.title: v0.8.0 Update
notes.notes:
Anita
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/f30771e03813571c7c815fffe859c09772bf060c.gif
They say that mushrooms are capable of emotions far more complex than we realize. “They” have never met a specimen like Anita, who is capable of much more emotion than even we are. I would go into more detail, but such items are lost on a crowd of sinners. Fortunately, Anita is here to spore you, which is a hideously painful process that involves mushrooms being shot at you at speeds rivaling algorithmic censorship, but that has also granted me powers beyond all dreams. 

…sorry, I was tripping. Anita was born after Rasputin's corpse regurgitated a mushroom that had his same dogged desire to live. She spawns after wave 64, the holiest of mushroom numbers. When she isn't hurtling her grown offspring at you, she'll be releasing waves of spores. Sure, her worst trait is easily her disregard for her own children, but her best quality is the way she looks at you. Become a mushroom today! 

Fungus Biome
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/d273a8d1e1f9166d9c8b83b829878dceb52a61d1.png
Like other beings of powerful personality, Anita's presence has begun to warp the land. Springing up everywhere are entire patches of small Anita's, referred to as Smallnitas. Smallnitas can vary in size, and some are large enough to make you think “wait a second, these pennies must be freakin’ enormous.” Many of them congregate together, forming massive colonies that you can now walk around and explore in a brand new biome. 

The Developer suggested I add a joke about athlete's foot in regards to this, but there's nothing funny about athlete's foot.  It's not even something I want to bring up, especially after the waY҉҉O҉҉U҉ ҉H҉҉A҉҉V҉҉E҉ ҉S҉҉T҉҉E҉҉P҉҉P҉҉E҉҉D҉ ҉B҉҉E҉҉Y҉҉O҉҉N҉҉D҉ ҉Y҉҉O҉҉U҉҉R҉ ҉B҉҉O҉҉U҉҉N҉҉D҉҉S҉ ҉W҉҉R҉҉I҉҉T҉҉E҉҉R҉

ATM
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/428f03cec8bfde748db64cbcab97055f956ee3ba.png
In honor of capitalism (the economic system that was first devised in Pennylooter), we have added ATMs - automated telemetry materials. These materials coalesce into greedy robots who we (in honor of capitalism) have inscripted into constant servitude. They will store your money and dispense it to your little desires. 

New Items
Debit Card
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/0729787c9def32f60819245db4b96de7b8a486c7.png
You trust us with your money, right? You probably even bought this game twice, which is going straight into the budget for game development and expensive candles. Try depositing $9.99 into an ATM to see the sweet, sweet content that we are allowed to produce thanks to your money - you'll get this shiny debit card, more ATMs, and a subtle sense of pride. 

Dev's Blessing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/7f6cc5fc4b5d003d699873e9dbcdde2fb285312e.png
The Developer loves you. As a symbol of that love, he has granted His most dedicated Looters his personal wings. You'll be faster. You'll be able to fly over water. You'll be able to quickly fly over water. The possibilities are endless. Unlock the Completely Untouchable achievement to show us you care. Pennylooter gave you wings. 

Rebound Jewel
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/8b60c00e4935914c587fa81c3dd0824385a3422f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/c49ca0321555ca45c0fcf7ea09fa2983795d6902.gif
The edges of reality are more like walls, and this little jewel proves it. By pumping your bullets full of magic chemicals (and magic amphetamines), your ammunition will learn to bounce. They grow up so fast…

Quantum Visor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/eb3267a89b35bc415e2625dd36ee81dd9461b3f6.png
By playing this game, you have agreed to allow your brainwaves to be uploaded into Pennylooter's super secure servers. We need that brain power for this brand new item: the Quantum Visor. We have finally cracked the code on quantum mechanics after we first invented the concept of “quantum” for this very game, and now you can use it to split bullets into more bullets and pick up more visors to spit out more bullets to pick up more visors… quantum physics is complicated. 

Cassidy's Head
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/9178069d286345c1013cb1ef4fa6e308b6f3620c.png
Cassidy feels great, thank you for asking. He's even offering up his head for some sweet, sweet greed points, symbolizing the fat cat that is gorged upon by even fatter cats in this beast of capital. With it, enemies will occasionally drop double their usual money rate. All wealth is imaginary, after all, and Cassidy has a mighty strong imagination. 
Cassidy and Anita were once close allies, until the checkers incident. Following his scattering, she claimed and holds this head, the most holy of Cassidy relics. Defeat her, and me-wowsers, you can look like a psychopath and hold it yourself. 

Cassidy's Paw
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/8dda57443750898d59528de8a53c1910332e656f.png
I know, I know - you haven't had a chance to dress up with enough animal parts. I've got the cure for what ails you - let Cassidy's little foot walk its way into your heart for a speed and damage up. The paws are where cats store their angst, which they feel as a result of not being able to play Pennylooter. 

Cassidy's Tail
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/96e3d28950ca8c5e403b4d8cdc7c12d9634a8cc4.png
We are DEDICATED to realism. So, inspired by the time I chased a bunch of people around with a disembodied cat's tail, this orange appendage will petrify the good wits out of the unlucky woodland creatures you are slaughtering. Prove you're worthy of holding the tail by taking out 5,000 (that's 1,000 five times) enemies in a single run. 

Cassidy's Brain Cell
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/f13339410be2bd0c8e44a2b668fe5f9948b7bc64.png
This little scumbag never thought a day in his life. This is not to imply he no longer exists - he's FINE, he just fell apart. We've all been there, eh? Only those who have held all of his other bits simultaneously may wield the brain cell. 

A spark of feline intellect will increase your critical hit chance, and decrease your chances of resisting laser pointers. 

Coupon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/832a4785fcbffc1f50a10d0ab3b2cb345baf37e1.png
Remember the Completely Untouchable achievement mentioned earlier? What if you just don't have it in you? Well, get the Untouchable achievement, and I guess we can give you this coupon instead, which increases likelihood of discounts in shops. Just keep in mind; no one will remember the couponers. 

Penny Cannon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/e203f2645e796759f2cb838ec90403fc8dd1be2c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/3b9ed738a5cd3e7113790b3d26bbb2cd3f63d5e7.gif
What if guns didn't have infinite ammo? What if they used your money? Okay, well, what if you were a seasoned, millionaire capitalist with a fortune of pennies to your name? These pennies have had it too good for too long! Put that fortune to use and become the millionaire you always dreamed of being. Load it all into this fella and show them all that guns don't kill people, but they can be paid to! 

Minigun
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/5b19486bd91b7b5021317c7e5abc631c56b35f4e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/0eb8e533e35512aaad61db1ba3c31c7518619e6b.gif
Some say that Lieutenant Timmy has a personal minigun that was granted to him following his first successful deployment. Some say he once loaded it with his baby teeth when he ran out of bullets. And still others say he would hand it out to whoever could best him in big-boy combat. Me? I would say, “beat Timmy on hard mode, and you'll get his favorite toy.” I keep it simple - like taking a minigun from a baby. 

Small Changes & Bug Fixes

 Joystick movement is much smoother now
 Prettier messages and a sound effect when unlocking an item/items
 Unlocking the Chef's Hat now requires defeating Chef Pete once in hard mode instead of defeating him 5 times
 Incoming wave warnings no longer show up if you're holding B to skip the cooldown 
 Fixed lag caused by lots of enemy explosions happening at once
 Fixed a crash that could happen when maxing out certain items

notes.title: v0.7.0 Update
notes.notes:
Danny Smiles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/cb8cf96b9ab3775885ad9ea8366b910bbeed9fe9.png
(Pictured: Danny with his finest grin and mascara)

Danny Smiles is what happens when you take a man at the end of his rope and offer him a way out. Unfortunately, the “way out” in this case was a crazed biologist armed with counterfeit stem cells and hundreds of teeth. Now, cursed with an infestation of permanently regenerating chompers, Danny does the only thing he can do: smile through the pain. This has driven him to madness, and now he desires that everyone else be forced into a similar Cheshire existence. By launching toothy projectiles at your purdy little mouth, Danny is what every Human Resources department yearns to be: an unceasing smile of infectious damnation.

His presence is an affront to God, dentists, and religious teeth-enjoyers all over the world. As a direct result, the fabric of reality is unweaving - you've literally never seen Pennylooter like this. Smile and wave, boys.

New Starting Items
Bubble
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/104b5e67673343ec372839e6373f0bf6723c3565.gif
(Pictured: Jeffrey Bobbles’ bubbles bopping) 

Danny Smiles HATES bubbles. Since he can't curve his lips, he can't blow any, and we all fear that which we cannot create. This rage has caused such an influx of energy that it has summoned a pack of wild Anti-Smile bubbles. They hate Danny because they can't smile. You hate Danny because you will never be as handsome as he is. It's a perfect match.
You can now start the game with one of these boisterous orbitals to begin unleashing waves of soapy projectiles.

Bee
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/c3867d83abed16c8e7852bf8dad71928d058910e.gif
This isn't the bee you see gallivanting around on the back of honey bottles, laughing like a hyena, as if there isn't a care to be had in this wretched world. This is a Penny Bee. Penny Bees do not make honey - they do not collect pollen - they do not care about flowers. They are carnivorous insects and demand living flesh as their sole source of nutrients. Now YOU can wield these mistakes of God as a starting item. Become the hive! Just remember: the Penny Bees call the shots. They pick their targets on their own. You are but a medium by which they will paint destruction. 

Penny Bees were thought to be extinct after the Penny of 1816 was minted, which caused untold destruction to 107% of the world. However, Danny Smiles' reality warping nature has brought them back. 

Other New Items
Radioactive Octopus
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/b86cf153ea7b067c7ba226883a93a7fd49362358.png
“But I'm not sure what to say about the tentacles, boss.” A gun clicks as it's pressed into the writer's back. “I didn't ask if you had anything to say about the tentacles. I told you to write something about them,” croaked The Developer, in a cold, crispy tone. “Tell them that they are unlocked at wave 30. And make it sound cool,” he slurped.

The tentacles are unlocked at wave 30. They are UNBELIEVABLY stylish and might be the single greatest addition to any video game ever. With these bad boys, your ability to reach out and touch someone will be not only be stronger than ever - it'll be deadly, dealing damage in a constant line. Each Radioactive Octopus adds a new appendage, for a maximum of 16. How exactly do the tentacles deal damage? Well, it's kind of like how your bad attitude makes me want to collapse onto the ground like a sack of potatoes and sob, “why God? Why do they question the patch notes?”

Musket
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/1be373a64df8c47818afe5422610197ed3bd99b5.png
(Pictured: my son, third birthday, with his prized musket)
Another temporal anomaly spawned by Mr. Smiles and his bizarre ontology, this musket's musk must be something fierce. This muzzle-loaded menace could tear a hole the size of the milky way through the whimsical forces you mercilessly slaughter for pennies, but be warned: your stubby little arms will take ages to reload this museum piece. 

Order Form
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/440246a490c5d098fb26e922f1f68065ae9db491.png
Don't you hate it when you go to the shop, only to find that they have plenty of Steroids, but not a single octopus? It's why I stopped shopping at Whole Foods. Fortunately, we have decided to inject a healthy dose of entrepreneurship into Pennylooter. Once you establish yourself as a consistent customer (meaning: you unlock the Businessperson achievement by buying and selling 1000 items), order forms will be unlocked. Use one, and your favorite shop will now stock one additional item. Use a million, and you'll accomplish very little as a result because there aren't a million items in the game, but I'll respect the hustle.

Stem Cells
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/4d76acdb7b7a82ba186796e446db3b41b8ef5e5f.png
I know what you must be thinking: “Are these the same stem cells that made Danny so attractive?” The answer is a resounding “no”, because you will never be that cool. But you can swallow these for a small damage up, like a deranged, power-hungry toddler. 
 
New UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/01b3f1304077692a27c5dc3aedbdb8503762812a.png
I used to look at the menus in this game and feel sick. Blue menu backgrounds? Hard corners? Buttons full of shame? 2024 is 2020-over, and we've changed - we promise! These menus are sleek, they're spectacular, and they're specifically designed to taste good with all of your favorite foods. If this doesn't please you, nothing ever will, and you will lose yourself in a quest of endless yearning. 

Smaller Changes

 Item unlocks are now permanent, and some items are now unlocked by getting achievements.
 New Item Catalogue menu that shows the items that you've unlocked (accessible from the stats menu).
 There's now a 50% chance that a random item in the shop will be discounted from between 25% and 90%, and a 2% chance that an item will be 100% off (free).
 Armor items will now appear under the apparel tab in the inventory and shop.
 The boat will now appear under the misc tab in the inventory and shop.
 The shop arrow is now hidden during combat.
 Chance to spawn Altars will not start incrementing until after wave 5.
 Lowered chance for Lieutenant Timmy's soldiers to drop their armor/weapons.
 Increased shop spawn rate.
 The strength of gamepad vibration when taking damage will now increase as the player's HP gets closer to zero.
 Reduced the amount of bananas and apples that can appear in the shop.
 Added a visual effect after using Steroids.
 Increased Rocked Launcher damage.
 Explosions have a bigger hitbox now.
 Cyclops Eye can be unlocked by killing 100 Cyclopes.
 Chef Pete no longer drops Chef's Hat when killed, but it can be unlocked for purchase in the shop by defeating Chef Pete 5 times. 
 Added a stat that tracks how many items the player has unlocked.
 Increased the amount of coins that are dropped in normal difficulty.
 Rebalanced shop spawn chances.
 Damage indicators are now purple on critical hits.
 Shopkeep's Heart now unlocks at wave 48.


Fixed:

 Audio didn't work with certain models of gaming headsets.
 A bug that caused the enemy spawn cooldown to slowly count down in the shop and when the game was paused.
 Blood Gun didn't have a description.
 Various UI bugs.
 A bug that allowed the enemy cooldown to be skipped during boss fights.

notes.title: v0.6.0 Update
notes.notes:
Lieutenant Timmy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/77fa70acc81b3f05a0fcf5ef5f10a35b0784e13d.gif
(Pictured: Lieutenant Timmy, casually tanking a thermonuclear bomb)
We have received your letters, and we couldn't agree more - Pennylooter has a severe lack of babies. With this in mind, a brand new boss has been deployed to the battlefield. This insidious infant has 5 stars in cute, but don't let that fool you; he was born at a very young age, and every moment since has been subsumed by war, famine, and rage. He will be born on wave 48. 

New Items
Sniper & Military Armor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/227d5afc0dbb94ae63feaa93f3c4e1105068ca65.png
Lieutenant Timmy didn't get to his rank by adopting an alpha-wolf, “I work alone,” attitude. From the moment he uttered the words “Gugaag….ghhhh,” his parents knew he was made to be a leader and enlisted him straight away. Now, he helms an entire team of soldiers. Being a lieutenant, his men are even younger than he is, causing them to drop their clothes and even their weapons as they lack both fine motor control and object permanence.

Rocket Launcher
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/995bfbe25ebaf2c4c1642f34792e3673b8e155da.gif
Timmy's insatiable bloodlust has lead to devastating consequences. However, the increasing military presence in the area doesn't have to mean it's Sally Sad Time. We are pleased to announce that Timmy's little shenanigans now mean that Rocket Launchers are within arm's reach of anyone who can afford them! If you still have them. Arms that is. Which I don't. What happened? Timmy happened. I'm typing this via voice-to-text. 

Blood Gun
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/a033847236f0e5475eaeeb706956da2cf4369d0f.gif
They say the developer came up with the idea for this weapon after his laptop ran out of battery, so he plugged the charger right into himself. He had access to a normal outlet, but you have access to normal guns and you still want to use this one because it's cool, yeah? Live a little, man. 

Repulser
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/2fc9adb54e12301742c138a8e9323535eeac6af9.png
Every solar system has its center, and we here at Pennylooter like to view YOU as the center of our little world. That being said, we understand if you need space. Just jam this rod through your skull, leave it stuck in your brain, and we promise that you will find others staying a bit farther away. 

New Enemies
Bomb Boys
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/d38b85b3daed49f02976ed7b26cb8f2df2ff6bb1.gif
You see that guy standing there in the gif? He died for this demonstration. Don't let it be in vain. The Bomb Boys are the most dangerous group of individuals to walk this forsaken planet, and all they want is a hug. But when you are born as a horrifying mash-up of human and TNT, every hug becomes more deadly than “Swimming in Syringes Saturdays” at the local pool. 

Mega Bomb Boys
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/3160962250ac45b3a8048bf8c5b133870e7ff155.gif
“What if the Bomb Boys tried to hug each other? Wouldn't that fix a lot of problems?” Calm down there, Oppenheimer. You aren't the first wide-eyed idealist to loot some pennies, and you aren’t the first to think that Bomb Boys can be dealt with peacefully. In-fact, they LOVE to hug each other. They do it so much, sometimes they merge into the dreaded Mega Bomb Boy.

Big Snowman
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/28682a9b48fb94f2b6b53858d9cbad98c94100f8.png
Of the two snowmen variety, Hominid Snowus Major is actually the less deadly of the two. That's because the smaller snowmen don't give a single hoot about your expectations, and have dedicated their lives to subverting them, while the bigger snowmen lazily coasted along, hoping their greater stature would be enough. It was, for a while, but then the snow market crashed, and they found work alongside their smaller cousins. Hard times makes for even harder snowmen.

Smaller Changes

 You now have a 2% chance to land a critical hit on enemies when using a gun or similar weapon.
 The Nimbility Implant now increases crit chance instead of movement speed (it still decreases reload time as well).
 Friended dogs are now invincible, have a nice red collar, and will also deal occasional contact damage to enemies.
 Friended dogs will teleport closer to the player if they end up really far away.
 Cut the speed boost given by the Speed Pill in half, also reduced the amount that can appear in a single shop to 1.
 Rebalanced the flesh biome. It's now slightly larger, and more common. Mob spawn rates have been adjusted, and Cyclopes now shoot projectiles.
 Rebalanced the snow biome. Small snow men don't spawn until wave 36, and big snow men will spawn starting at wave 10. Also, the snowballs fired by snow men are much easier to see now.
 Enemies will now spawn more quickly as you progress through the game.
 The Buisinessperson achievement is now triggered by your stats across all saves.
 Added a new achievement for taking 50,000 damage across all saves.
 Slightly increased the shop spawn rate in both hard mode and normal mode.
 Improved the behavior of the Coin Magnet.
 Slightly increased rarity of Speed Pill, Shopkeep's Heart, and Can of Tuna.
 Reduced Chef Pete's HP.


Bug Fixes

 Using the Writ of Blood would cause fewer enemies to spawn.
 Sometimes a notification would appear warning of an incoming boss fight when there was in fact no incoming boss fight.
 Sometimes a purple arrow would appear to indicate that an Altar had spawned, but the Altar would be impossible to find. 
 Loading a save file during a boss fight would cause the boss to spawn with full hp. 
 Loading a save file during a boss fight would cause the wrong music to play.
 Fixed a crash that could occur with certain audio devices.

notes.title: v0.5.0 Update
notes.notes:
Chef Pete
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/8fcbb0a25400dd92cc8b2cac5081057302aaa25c.gif
After clearing wave 39, you'll be greeted by this kind fella and his cheeseburger pals. 
Good luck.

New Items
Thor's Phone
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/231c2ad0bf4983c5a9b6910ca6cad42ad5ecb577.png
A cell phone with the skies on speed dial.
Using this item will cause lightning to occasionally strike nearby, damaging enemies. 

Wristwatch
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/c41f56536dd1954f98cfbdaede7fc12e980aad3f.png
This exquisite watch will increase the cooldown time between waves by 30 seconds. Each watch you use will increase the cooldown time by 30 more seconds. (Remember that cooldowns can be skipped by holding B on either the keyboard or gamepad).

Nimbility Implant
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/eb4e251f651bc9af853dbaea477d51287b2d5951.png
A surgically implanted chip that rewires your brain, allowing you to reload your weapons 25% faster and run a little quicker. 
The chip is implanted by the shopkeep. It should be noted that the shopkeep does not have a medical license. 

Speed Pill
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/5f09e3c53c758535a876c13797ebc182db1960f4.png
A nice, tasty pill that increases your movement speed twice as much as the Nimbility Implant.

Can of Soup
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/01c9a7485b27a37a56b0e37ef417466a8b674259.png
Homemade soup cooked by the shopkeep himself. 
Restores a random amount of HP between 50 and 100.

Shopkeep's Heart
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/ed60353008c4e1caf0b9e327c6a818c54eb0fb93.png
Sometimes shopkeeps will become desperate to feed their families, and will offer their heart for sale.
Consuming this fully restores your HP, but results in the death of the shopkeep you buy it from.

Chef's Hat
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/33f005b31228b8d048c2eb0120693b25478fa1fe.png
After defeating Chef Pete, he'll drop his hat, which you can then wear yourself, increasing the effectiveness of consumed food items by 25%.

Cheeseburger
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/22acce3e9d5876871f11ca716e722deebf2a80c1.png
A plain cheeseburger, occasionally dropped by Chef Pete's friends.
Restores 45 HP.

Music
There's music now. You'll love it.
But if you don't, music and sfx volume can be configured in the new audio settings menu (accessible from the regular settings menu).

Achievements
There's now separate achievements for beating each boss in hard mode, plus separate hardmode achievements for Slippery, Untouchable, and Unstoppable.
There's also a new achievement for rolling/dodging 20,000 times across all saves.
Plus a new hidden achievement.

Smaller changes & bug fixes

 Reduced the amount of Potions of Bad Vibes that could be given by the altar.
 There is now a chance that the altar will spawn nearby when you clear a wave. This chance starts at 0%, and will increase by 5% for each wave you clear without taking damage, up to a max of 50% at ten waves in a row with no damage. This chance resets to zero if you take damage during a wave, or if an altar spawns.
 Slightly reduced the chance of an altar spawning naturally on mountaintops.
 The shopkeep wears clothes again.
 Projectile-firing enemies start spawning at wave 10 now instead of wave 16.
 Adjusted difficulty for projectile-firing enemies (reduced their HP in hard mode and reduced fire rates & projectile velocities).
 The SMG and assault rifle now unlock at wave 16 instead of wave 17.
 The player now has 0.25 seconds of invincibility after taking damage.
 Added a visual effect to the player after consuming Bottle of Milk.
 Made Phillip McTree's chase attack a little more aggressive.
 Reduced the amount of rings of cream balls spawned by Arnold Creamston from 10 to 5.
 Fixed a bug that could cause shops to spawn with their doors over water, which would make them inaccessible.

notes.title: v0.4.0 Update
notes.notes:
No More Ammo
Before this update, half of the gameplay was making sure you had enough ammo to beat the next boss. That kinda sucked, so I got rid of ammo. As a result, the entire currency and shop system has been reworked, and the whole game has been rebalanced. (Note that you still need to reload guns, you just don't have to actually have any ammo. In other words, guns now have infinite ammo).

This is unrelated, but I should also mention that the default dodge button on gamepads is now left bumper instead of A. This can of course be changed in the control bindings menu.

Anyway here's the fun stuff:

Bosses
Phillip McTree
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/263b8a5bb19b7a25c46288791aa8c970062d541a.gif
This gentleman will greet you at once you clear wave 7. He's really fast. Watch out.

Arnold Creamston
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/921de1741a26b6e77d6d1ec933fdde8062febdc7.gif
Arny here shows up 8 waves after Professor Hands, at wave 32. I don't recommend getting to close to him, despite his pleasant, creamy appearance. 

Guns
Autopistol
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/af49e837de5967b3046db30a7c8e883801e8d984.png
The autopistol is an automatic pistol that holds 8 rounds and unlocks at wave 3.

SMG
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/8d92fca59016395b101c6a97b0da762081fba6c0.png
Shoots real fast. Faster than the assault rifle, but with a bit less damage. Use with caution. Unlocks at wave 17.

New Items
Funny Mushroom
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/849cc383a7e0de97edd7e4c217b9432ea5f21e60.gif
The funny mushroom is a new starting item that will cause you to grow a third eye when you eat it. If there are enemies nearby, your new eye will fire purple projectiles in the direction you're looking. You can aim it the same way you'd aim a gun. Like the potion of bad vibes, eating more funny mushrooms will improve its stats.

Writ of Blood
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/2926780a0d6a6b98b7e7b4743484d9b164e970aa.png
A nice contract you can sign that will give you a massive damage boost at the expense of 50% of your max hp. Unlocks at wave 9.

New Features and stuff
The Altar
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/8f2e5282594b3bef8a52a95db6ba5f4ed6b7fa9d.gif
The Altar is a rare building that can sometimes spawn at the tops of mountains (in the snowy part), or, even more rarely, in the tundra biome. When you get close to it, it will activate and present you with either a stat increase or a gift. 

Hard Mode
Once you've finished the tutorial, you'll be given the option of enabling hard mode the next time you start a new run. In hard mode, all damage you take will be doubled, and there will be twice the amount of enemies (which means twice the amount of pennies! wow). Also, bosses have a bit more hp.

Crypticus Armor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/3525794a2c047544276e31ffb3e5ceaae47ecc8f.png
This is a rare armor set that you have a chance to get when you activate an altar. There's also a small chance for pieces of this armor to spawn in a shop. 

Death Screen
Now, instead of being returned to the main menu when you die, you'll get to see a nice little screen that shows you your stats for the run you just lost. 

Other changes

 The achievements for running/swimming/sailing a certain distance are now triggered via your overall stats. Before, they were set using your stats for an individual run, which made getting these achievements excessively difficult.
 The more challenging enemies that were introduced in the last update now spawn at wave 24, after you defeat Professor Hands. I don't remember what wave they spawned at before but I remember that I changed it.
 Professor Hands now spawns at wave 24 instead of wave 32, so there is now a boss fight every 8 waves up to wave 32.
 Increased shop spawn rate a bit.
 Lowered the speed of the snowballs shot by snowmen.
 Retextured snowmen.

notes.title: v0.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
New enemies
Starting at wave 26, some new enemies will start to spawn. Which ones you'll see will depend on the biome you find yourself in. These enemies are a bit more robust than the enemies you're used to, and they all fire projectiles, so... watch out I guess.

Difficulty changes
In addition to the new enemies, the rate that enemies spawn at will now increase as you progress. Also, William Cheesequake will start bringing his friends to fight you once you reach wave 50. 

Performance improvements
So it turns out the game would get super laggy once you got to the point where hundreds of enemies were spawning every wave. So I yelled at the game a little bit and now it's not so laggy. Enjoy 800 enemies firing tens of thousands of projectiles at you at a smooth 60 frames per second. 

Additionally, terrain generation should be from around 25% to up to 50% faster on some devices. If you're playing this game on an ancient device, you shouldn't have to worry about running into the void anymore. 
Note that this required a sort of "reset" of the terrain generation. Any worlds you had saved will probably look different.

Healthy Stench
The Healthy Stench is a nice little perfume that, when applied, will heal 5% of your HP every 5 seconds for 2 minutes. It unlocks at wave 90.

Other changes and bug fixes

 New orbiters will now spawn directly below the player when equipped
 Fixed a bug that could occur during boss fights when the game autosaved
 Protein Shake now heals 50 HP instead of 100% of the player's HP
 Assault rifle and rifle rounds now unlock at wave 17 instead of wave 16

notes.title: v0.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
Biomes
The Flesh Biome
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/03c4e935af454761e39002d51f3b4cacc2bf46c7.png
The floor is moist here...
Flesh biomes are vast, but rare. You'll have to travel quite a ways to find one. Once you do, you'll encounter some rather unnerving creatures.

The Forest
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/52e4e49422bdd3f5eeb3ccef63e3c32dda7a210c.png
Start your new life as a lumberjack.
The ideal place for collecting wood and apples, forests are littered with trees.

Bosses
William Cheesequake
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/82a2b2a4aa437d9d37629c5f4b79b5386df65c7b.gif
Claims to be "made of cheese."
Don't let his looks deceive you, he's kinda scary. 
William appears after wave 15.

Professor Hands
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/dc78d48eb8d550e33c303474826ab0ce38fdab9b.png
Despite the name, he doesn't have any hands. He won't tell anybody what happened to them.
Smells weird.
Appears after wave 31.

Weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068495/4593004be3861bb712f7811633259b8ceda25e3a.gif
Autolaser
Like the laser pistol, but automatic. Also does a little bit more damage.

Chainsaw
Eviscerate trees (or enemies, if you'd prefer). Powered by gasoline.

Railgun
Shoots railgun darts. Really fast. Also, it'll shoot through up to five enemies.

Bow and arrow
A nice starting weapon. The shopkeep manufactures these himself. If you're a bad shot, you can pick up your arrows that miss their mark.

New Features
Diagonal movement
You're no longer confined to four movement directions! Congrats. 

Autosave
The game now autosaves a couple times every minute, so if the game crashes in the middle of run, not all is lost.

Stats
Check out the stats menu to see stats per save and overall such as distance travelled, enemies defeated, etc.

Cooldown speedup
Hold B to speed up the cooldown between waves if you get impatient (configurable in the control bindings menu).

Shop progression
New items will now unlock each time you defeat a wave. Some items cannot be bought, and must be found by exploring the world and defeating enemies. 

New Items

 Liquid Exercise: Increases max stamina
 Cactus flesh: The desert analogue to wood, it can be collected by cutting down cactuses, and can be sold to the shopkeep
 Fingernail: The shopkeep LOVES these. Get some by cutting down the fingers growing in the flesh biome
 Eye orbiter: Rarely dropped by Cyclopes in the flesh biome 
 Cheese: dropped by William Cheesequake. Heals 20 HP.


Other changes

 Changed some prices of shop items (hopefully better balanced)
 Liquid nap now increases stamina recover rate, instead of restoring stamina
 Fixed invincibility frames while dodging
 If the shopkeep has a gun, he will now always have the appropriate ammo for that gun
 Pennies on the ground are animated now
 Fixed a crash that could occur when using the inventory or shop menu
